Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Amie's premium paywall - a sheet expands full-screen into "The everyday package" with glossy 3D blob icons (blue center, orange and pink flanking), a staggered checklist of features with colored icons, Yearly/Monthly plan rows with a SAVE badge, and a "Start my 7-day trial" button.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
White paywall: "The everyday package" title, three squishy 3D blobs (calendar, envelope, checkbox glyphs embossed), a feature list (colored bullet icons with green checks), plan rows (Yearly with price + "SAVE X%" badge, Monthly), and a dark "Start my 7-day trial" button pinned bottom.

## Motion spec
Pattern: springy paywall reveal with staggered value props.
- The sheet expands from its trigger to full screen (spring ~320/22, gentle overshoot at the top edge).
- The blobs drop in: center blob first (scale 0.4 -> 1, spring ~340/14 - a fat squishy bounce with +-4deg rotation settle), the side blobs 100ms later at 0.8 scale, all three idling with a slow hover (+-6px, 2.8s sine, phase-offset).
- Feature rows stagger in (fade + 12px rise, 250ms, 60ms apart), their check icons popping a beat after each row (scale 0.6 -> 1, spring ~460/18).
- Plan rows slide up last; the SAVE badge shimmers once (a light sweep, 400ms).
- Selecting a plan: its radio fills with a springy dot (scale 0 -> 1.2 -> 1) and the row's border tints; the trial button pulses once.

## Calibration
- Yearly is preselected - the badge does its selling with one shimmer, not a loop.
- Blobs are glossy with soft shadows - toy-like, not flat icons.

## Reduced motion
Everything fades in statically; no blob hover.

## Don't miss
- The blobs are the brand moment - 3D, squishy, and alive; flat icons would flatten the price ask.
- The stagger ends at the price - the eye lands on the plans exactly as the motion stops.
